_meta.name: NCCI Procedure-to-Procedure (PTP) edits
_meta.status: EMPTY — must be populated from real CMS NCCI PTP files, filtered to BHW's codes.
_meta.shape: { "Col1Code|Col2Code": "0"|"1"|"9" } where the value is the NCCI modifier indicator (0 = never unbundle, 1 = allowed with a documented override modifier, 9 = deleted/NA).
_meta.guardrail: Do NOT hand-type or guess pairs. Load them from the CMS quarterly NCCI PTP tables (Medicare and Medicaid have different tables — key by payer or keep two files). The engine reports rule 'ncci-ptp' as inactive until this is non-empty.
